insights.finding: High promotion-gap personnel attend fewer developmental programs.
insights.metric: Average 2.6 trainings last year (vs. 2.6 for low-gap personnel).
insights.implication: Stagnation is reinforced by a lack of continuous capability building.
insights.recommended_action: Sponsor targeted technical or leadership reskilling tracks for stalled talent.

insights.finding: Extended tenure with the same manager correlates with higher promotion gap ratios.
insights.metric: 63.5% avg gap ratio for 5+ yrs with manager vs 35.2% for <5 yrs.
insights.implication: Possible managerial familiarity inertia or lack of external sponsorship.
insights.recommended_action: Establish cross-functional talent committee reviews to complement direct manager appraisals.

insights.finding: 213 high-performing, currently satisfied employees are experiencing severe career stalling.
insights.comparison: Satisfaction scores $\ge$ 2.0, but unpromoted for $\ge$ 4.0 years.
insights.implication: These individuals are in the critical 12-to-18 month pre-disengagement window.
insights.recommended_action: Initiate proactive internal mobility reviews and executive sponsorship before active turnover occurs.
